problem.description: On 25th of November at 13:25 GMT an issue occurred with the GLOBE Portal, which authenticates users and provides access to the SAP systems. Users in all zones including NBS locations experienced very slow performance and time outs, when attempting to access the SAP systems via the portal. IT teams worked over the next hours to alleviate the performance issue with the support of the vendor (SAP) and investigate the cause. Portal performance was improved by 20:30 GMT, and users confirmed a return to normal business operations. IT teams continued to monitor the systems to ensure no further disruption, and the issue was declared resolved at 03:50 GMT November 26 2020.
